messages:
Incident Bot: pagerduty: page fired -> service=redwood-support-prod, incident=PDINC12345, urgency=high :rotating_light:
PagerDuty Bot: Autogenerated alert: prod-inference-api error-rate spike > 8% (5m). Linked runbook: https://internal/runbooks/inference-rate-spike
SRE Oncall (Noah): i'm getting the page, but the service looks wrong — support team was paged instead of inference. pinging @Maria Chen and @Ajay Patel
Maria Chen: omg yeah that looks like the support service binding. i saw a deploy to pd-tag-syncer yesterday. could be a tag drift.
Ajay Patel: confirming — the alert originally came from "prod-inference-api" but the PD rule has a fallback to "redwood-support-prod" when tag missing. looks like the inference service lost tag "team:inference"
Emily Park: @Ajay can you run `pd service show PD-SVC-INF` and `pd service show PD-SVC-SUPPORT`? i want to see recent binding changes
Ajay Patel: paste: ```
# pd service show PD-SVC-INF
Last modified: 2026-02-23T21:10:11Z
Tags: env:prod, team:inference
Bindings: infra-oncall

# pd service show PD-SVC-SUPPORT
Last modified: 2026-03-01T03:02:05Z
Tags: env:prod
Bindings: support-oncall
```
Noah: so the inference service still has the tag, but the alert router (pager-syncer) pushed a stale binding with lower priority, causing fallback. i'm going to pause the support service rule for this alert key.
Maria Chen: please escalate manually to inference oncall in PD and also DM the oncall channel — this is customer impacting. customers seeing 5xx on the embed endpoint.
PagerDuty Bot: manual trigger: PDINC12346 -> routed to PD-SVC-INF, escalation policy: inference-oncall -> ack_required
SRE Oncall (Noah): acked PDINC12346 :white_check_mark: taking incident. triage: high 5xx spike, partial region impact (us-west), estimated affected requests ~2.3k/min
Lisa Nguyen: support is getting a lot of threads, sorry for the noise. i've silenced the support-binding alert for the next 30m to stop duplicate pages :zipper_mouth_face:
Ajay Patel: root cause hypothesis: pd-tag-syncer job missed a delta and re-applied a legacy fallback routing rule during a config rollout at ~03:02Z. i'll open a ticket and revert the rollout.
Emily Park: mitigation plan: 1) keep support service silenced for this alert key 2) rebind PD-SVC-INF as primary for prod-inference-api 3) rollback pd-tag-syncer change 4) monitor error-rate and latency 5) notify customers if >10% errors for >10m
Maria Chen: assigning incident role: incident commander = Noah, comms = Lisa, SRE lead = Ajay, platform = Emily
Noah: running quick checks: scaling pools, checking GPU serving logs. also enabling expanded logs for kv-cache hits.
Maria Chen: @here can we get a one-line customer impact we can paste to the status page?
Noah: status update draft: "Partial outage for embed and batch-inference in us-west causing 5xx errors for ~15% of requests since 03:00Z; mitigation in progress, routing fix applied to correct on-call and rollback underway."
Lisa Nguyen: posting to status page now + PR to support inbox to set expectation: ETA 30-45m
Ajay Patel: pd-tag-syncer rollback started (job id: 20260315-rollback-7). stopping new sync pushes and reverting to previous release.
PagerDuty Bot: PDINC12345 (original) auto-resolved due to fallback suppression
Maria Chen: good. @Emily please keep an eye on the rollback metrics. if we see error-rate cross 12% then escalate to execs.
Emily Park: will do, hooking Cloudwatch alarms and Grafana dashboard panels to the incident.
Noah: quick note: oncall handoff in 40m — if still active i'll do a warm handoff to next oncall and add runbook links.
Lisa Nguyen: accepted, i'll handle external comms for the handoff and update customers at 30m cadence :loudspeaker:
Ajay Patel: follow-ups: (1) add a unit test for pd-tag-syncer for fallback rules, (2) add an alert that detects multiple services being paged for same alert key, (3) postmortem owner TBC
Noah: copy. for now: mitigation = rollback complete in ~8m, monitoring for error-rate and duplicate pages. triage notes saved to incident doc: https://internal/incidents/PDINC12346
Incident Bot: incident update: PDINC12346 status=investigating, assignees=[Noah,Ajay,Emily,Lisa], severity=high
Maria Chen: thumbs :thumbsup: great coordination. keeping this thread for postmortem notes.
Noah: ack handoff plan: if still active at 40m i'll DM the next oncall (Ajay) and do a voice handoff. if resolved before that we'll wrap and close.
